subject.title: fix: keep tail alive and replay timed-out messages

question: Should the fail-closed ordered-timeout and exact-message replay behavior in this PR become the default Discord tail recovery path now?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and the earlier defects are fixed, but tests cannot fully settle the operational message-delivery tradeoff introduced by restarting on detached ordered handlers and replaying exact messages behind an advanced cursor.

options.title: Merge after focused review
options.body: Accept the bounded residual delivery risk after reviewing the timeout, ledger, and replay invariants on the current head.

options.title: Request controlled live proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Discord run showing durable failure creation, restart, exact-message recovery, and unchanged cursor/event state before merging.

options.title: Hold the recovery design
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers prefer a narrower tail-liveness fix without introducing exact-message replay and its new operational surface.

recommendation.title: Merge after focused review
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded residual delivery risk after reviewing the timeout, ledger, and replay invariants on the current head.
